title: See with his fingers
html_source: Dermo-optical perception (DOP) — also known as dermal vision, dermo-optics, skin reading, finger vision — is a term that is used in parapsychological literature to denote the alleged capability to perceive colors, differences in brightness, and/or formed images through the skin especially upon touching with the fingertips. The effect has not been demonstrated scientifically.
